name: What is AEO and how can it help my small business?
description: AEO uses AI to improve your small business's online visibility, helping it appear higher in AI-driven search results and engage customers more effectively.

mainEntity.name: What is AEO and how can it help my small business?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO, or AI Engine Optimization, is a strategy that uses artificial intelligence to enhance your business's online visibility. Unlike traditional SEO, AEO leverages AI algorithms to understand user intent, analyze search patterns, and optimize content for how AI-driven search engines and voice assistants interpret information. For small businesses, this means improved discoverability in AI-powered search results, better engagement with potential customers through personalized experiences, and more efficient allocation of marketing resources by focusing on high-impact areas identified by AI. It aims to position your business prominently where customers are using advanced search technologies.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO uses AI to improve your small business's online visibility, helping it appear higher in AI-driven search results and engage customers more effectively.
